emergence.summary: An autosomal-recessive cause of severe early-onset obesity -- the RECEPTOR-side partner of congenital leptin deficiency. LEPR encodes the leptin receptor on hypothalamic POMC / AgRP neurons; it TRANSDUCES the leptin satiety signal that ACCELERATES the satiety / energy-expenditure programme (LEPR -> JAK2/STAT3 -> POMC -> alpha-MSH -> MC4R). Biallelic LEPR loss-of-function leaves the receptor unable to transduce leptin -> the satiety drive is lost DESPITE high (often markedly elevated) circulating leptin -> the emergent hormone-signalling axis falls -> intense hyperphagia and severe early-onset obesity (with hypogonadotropic hypogonadism). Because the axis is driven DOWN the corrective direction is UP -- but the KEY CONTRAST to congenital leptin deficiency is that REPLACING THE LIGAND DOES NOT WORK: leptin is already present, so metreleptin cannot rescue a broken receptor. Instead the kit re-derives a DOWNSTREAM BYPASS -- the melanocortin-4-receptor (MC4R) agonist setmelanotide drives the node BELOW the missing receptor, restoring the satiety signal the broken receptor failed to transduce; setmelanotide is FDA-approved (2020) and EMA-approved (2021) for obesity due to LEPR deficiency (and POMC / PCSK1 deficiency), re-deriving the receptor-bypass lever as the approved lead. This is the EXACT CONTRAST PARTNER to congenital leptin deficiency on the SAME satiety cascade: LEP-ligand deficiency -> REPLACE the ligand (metreleptin); LEPR-receptor deficiency -> BYPASS the receptor downstream (setmelanotide) -- a clean ligand-replace vs receptor-bypass pair, the boundary the congenital-leptin-deficiency entry already named, now resolved on its own DNA. The switch-level corrective (restore LEPR itself) is investigational. Leptin replacement is deliberately NOT listed as a lever here (ligand present, receptor broken). The gamma read is of the LEPR promoter switch STRUCTURE; the disease lesions are coding/splice (e.g. the original homozygous splice allele; truncating variants), outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: leptin-receptor satiety-signalling tone (the hypothalamic energy-balance set-point transduced from leptin) -- a hormone-signalling axis; the receptor-side partner of LEP-ligand deficiency

per_gene.note: LEPR encodes the leptin receptor (a type-I cytokine receptor) on hypothalamic POMC / AgRP neurons that TRANSDUCES the leptin signal accelerating the satiety / energy-expenditure programme (JAK2 / STAT3 -> POMC -> alpha-MSH -> MC4R). It is a signal-transducing ACCELERATOR of satiety; biallelic LOF leaves leptin unable to signal (despite high circulating leptin) -> the satiety drive is under-driven -> the hormone-signalling axis falls (axis DOWN), giving hyperphagia and severe early-onset obesity. 1p31.3 (OMIM 601007). NCBI official symbol LEPR. Autosomal recessive. Coding/splice lesions; promoter firewall respected.
per_gene.src: Clement 1998 Nature 392:398 (LEPR mutation -> morbid obesity); Farooqi 2007 NEJM 356:237 (clinical spectrum of LEPR deficiency)

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: agonise MC4R, the node downstream of the missing receptor -> restore the satiety signal the broken LEPR failed to transduce -> raise the under-driven axis toward normal (axis UP). A DOWNSTREAM receptor-bypass: it does NOT repair LEPR
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] degree of hyperphagia / adiposity normalisation not derived from sequence; downstream bypass of the receptor defect
levers.src: Clement 2020 Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol 8:960 (setmelanotide in LEPR / POMC deficiency); setmelanotide (Imcivree) FDA 2020 / EMA 2021 (approved for LEPR deficiency obesity)

levers.push_direction: restore the leptin receptor itself -> re-enable leptin signal transduction -> raise the satiety axis (axis UP); the switch-level corrective, repairing the deficient receptor rather than bypassing it
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] restored-receptor signalling not derived from sequence; investigational
levers.src: leptin-melanocortin pathway gene-restoration principle; no approved LEPR gene therapy

treatment_A_switch.firewall: levers are DIRECTION + cited agent CLASS; not dose/potency/efficacy/safety, not a recommendation to treat any individual.

falsifiers.claim: LEPR loss lowers transduced satiety-signal tone (axis DOWN) producing hyperphagia despite high circulating leptin
falsifiers.falsifier: a LEPR LOF genotype that REDUCED food intake / adiposity, or in which leptin replacement normalised intake (which would mean the receptor was dispensable), refutes the receptor-deficiency (axis-DOWN) direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: ad-libitum energy intake / satiety and fat mass versus serum leptin, and the (absent) response to metreleptin, stratified by LEPR genotype

falsifiers.claim: bypassing the broken receptor with a downstream MC4R agonist is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if setmelanotide failed to reduce hyperphagia / body weight in genetically confirmed LEPR deficiency, the potentiate-MC4R bypass lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: change in hunger score and body weight on setmelanotide in LEPR deficiency (the Clement 2020 design)

gate_falsifiers.gate: falsifier register (>=1 measurable falsifier per disease)
